description: Creates a trailer list on zinema.tv from movie and TV show titles. In apps that support interactive results, the trailers play in the conversation; the returned link opens the same list in a browser, with each trailer in the requested language when a dub exists. Use when the user asks for movie or show recommendations, or wants to see trailers for specific titles. Returns, for each title, what it matched (title, year, TMDB id) and whether a trailer is playable now, pending, or unavailable.

items.description: Your recommended titles, in the order you want them to play.

kind.description: Disambiguates a movie from a show with the same title.

tmdb.description: TMDB id if you know it.

language.description: Language of your conversation with the user. Drives trailer language (original-with-subtitles when no dub exists), page wording and localized titles.

title.description: Optional page title, e.g. 'Slow-burn thrillers for tonight'. Plain text, no URLs.

name: create_list
title: Create a playable trailer list
